verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own repository documents an Emscripten/WASM build that runs in a browser, and hands-on reports show it loading and accepting text input in Chrome, so a browser-only route exists. It is only a glancing fit: users report a ~300MB download, sluggish performance, no working cache, and a crash in Safari. The documented conversion feature (--convert-to) is a CLI flag for the installed app, not something shown working in the browser. Missing for 10: evidence that file conversion works in the browser build, an official hosted no-install offering, reliable cross-browser support, and acceptable load and performance for a quick one-off task.

support.subject: As a power user, a one-off conversion works in the browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: Emscripten / WASM: Runtime: a browser with SharedMemory support (threads + atomics)
